# You've Come a Long Way

#### Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen

## You've Come a Long Way

You've made a lot of changes across this course. rem units, media queries, flex-wrap, a hamburger menu, fluid images. But have you actually seen it all working together on your real portfolio?

That's what this lesson is about. Opening your actual portfolio code and checking it at the widths that matter.

The three widths worth testing are 320px, the narrowest phone still in use, 768px, a tablet, and 1024px, a small desktop. If it looks good at all three you're in good shape.

![Three widths. That's all you need to check.](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

▶️ Next, your responsive toolkit.
